question: Who is the Chairman of Rajya Sabha? (As of August 12, 2022)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar** is the current Chairman of Rajya Sabha as of August 12, 2022.
 
• The Chairman of Rajya Sabha is also the Vice President of India.
 
• The role of the Chairman includes presiding over the sessions of the Rajya Sabha, maintaining order, and ensuring the rules of the house are followed.
 
• The Chairman has the authority to decide on points of order and can also cast a deciding vote in case of a tie.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Rajya Sabha**, also known as the Council of States, is the upper house of India's bicameral Parliament.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution, but one-third of its members retire every two years.
 
• The Vice President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of members of both houses of Parliament.
 
• The Vice President serves as the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.
 
• The current Vice President and Chairman of Rajya Sabha, **Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar**, took office on August 11, 2022.
